How To Create A Modal - Pop Up Box Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000052780 This article demonstrates how to create a basic modal pop-up that can display custom content on a website. The example uses a custom widget to define the modal's HTML and JavaScript, then displays it on a selected page. Note This example provides a basic modal template. Some content, such as signup forms or other interactive elements, may require additional customization to function correctly inside a modal.
